title: tessera.eval-spec/1
description: What `tessera-quant eval` measures D on (02 §2.1, RFC-0005 'Fidelity evaluation'). The calibration source is the dataset D was calibrated on: its calibration set is redrawn from D's provenance, checked by the selection digest, and no evaluation sequence comes from one of its documents. The documents and prompts are drawn from `--seed`, as `tessera_quant.fidelity.select` defines. Paths are relative to the file. `tessera_quant.cli` reads it strictly: no key may be missing or unknown.

documents.description: The perplexity documents: each the beginning-of-text token and a document's first tokens, at most `max_tokens` in all.

prompts.description: The agreement prompts: each the beginning-of-text token and a document's first `tokens - 1` tokens; shorter documents are skipped.

continuation.description: The reference's greedy tokens after each prompt, the agreement trials: 256 by RFC-0005. With the prompt, at most the model's context.

source.description: A dataset: the string "c4", C4's `en` validation split at the revision RFC-0005 pins, fetched from the Hugging Face Hub; or JSON-lines files of `text` fields, gzip-compressed when a name ends in `.gz`, read in order, with the identity the report records.
